audit_events_supersession_all_or_nothing.name: audit_events_supersession_all_or_nothing
audit_events_supersession_all_or_nothing.value:
(supersedes_event_id IS NULL AND supersedes_occurred_at IS NULL AND supersession_kind IS NULL AND supersession_reason IS NULL)
          OR (supersedes_event_id IS NOT NULL AND supersedes_occurred_at IS NOT NULL AND supersession_kind IS NOT NULL)

audit_events_supersession_kind_valid.name: audit_events_supersession_kind_valid
audit_events_supersession_kind_valid.value: supersession_kind IS NULL OR supersession_kind IN ('correction', 'retraction')

audit_events_supersession_reason_require.name: audit_events_supersession_reason_required
audit_events_supersession_reason_require.value: supersedes_event_id IS NULL OR (supersession_reason IS NOT NULL AND btrim(supersession_reason) <> '')

audit_events_supersession_actor_identifi.name: audit_events_supersession_actor_identified
audit_events_supersession_actor_identifi.value: supersedes_event_id IS NULL OR (actor_type = 'user' AND actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND actor_label IS NOT NULL)

audit_events_supersession_after_target.name: audit_events_supersession_after_target
audit_events_supersession_after_target.value: supersedes_occurred_at IS NULL OR supersedes_occurred_at <= occurred_at

audit_events_correction_has_after_state.name: audit_events_correction_has_after_state
audit_events_correction_has_after_state.value: supersession_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'correction' OR after_state IS NOT NULL

employees_not_own_manager.name: employees_not_own_manager
employees_not_own_manager.value: reports_to_employee_id IS NULL OR reports_to_employee_id <> id

project_role_grants_revoked_after_grante.name: project_role_grants_revoked_after_granted
project_role_grants_revoked_after_grante.value: revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= granted_at

project_role_grants_revoker_implies_revo.name: project_role_grants_revoker_implies_revoked
project_role_grants_revoker_implies_revo.value: revoked_by_user_id IS NULL OR revoked_at IS NOT NULL
